text:
samira_ops: Heads up — 12x H200s from Atlas (AWB 123-45678901) are being held in FRA customs. Forwarder flagged an HS code mismatch. We need an RMA + a plan for temporary loaners to cover capacity tomorrow morning.

oliver_vendor: Sorry — saw this. We raised the reclassification with our customs lead earlier, but can also push an expedite. Confirming: these are replacements (RMA) not new purchases, right?

samira_ops: Correct, replacements for DOA batch. Prod is already at 85% GPU usage in eu-west1, so we need at least 6 loaners on site by EOD to avoid infra degradation.

nate_procure: Oliver, can vendor absorb customs brokerage expedite and any detention fees? We budgeted a contingency but prefer vendor credit.

oliver_vendor: We can cover expedited brokerage + detention up to EUR 5k. Anything beyond we need to split 50/50. We'll also send serialized manifest and COA in the next 30m.

claire_hw: If we get 6 loaners from the EU pool we can hot-swap and keep KV caches warm. Which depot would they go to? FRA airport DC or AMS crossdock? 

samira_ops: FRA preferred — shorter handoff. Can forwarder consolidate to new AWB for faster clearance?

forwarder_bot: Update: carrier confirms AWB consolidation possible. Proposed new AWB 987-65432109 (DHL) — ETA customs clearance attempt 16:00 CET if docs uploaded by 12:00 CET.

samira_ops: OK — oliver, please upload corrected HS (8471.80) + RMA paperwork to carrier portal now. Also need serial manifest in CSV. Pls include DOA reference PR-2026-042.

oliver_vendor: Uploaded docs and manifest. CSV snippet below:
```
serial,model,status
H200-AX12-001,H200,replace
H200-AX12-002,H200,replace
H200-AX12-003,H200,replace
H200-AX12-004,H200,replace
H200-AX12-005,H200,replace
H200-AX12-006,H200,replace
H200-AX12-007,H200,replace
H200-AX12-008,H200,replace
H200-AX12-009,H200,replace
H200-AX12-010,H200,replace
H200-AX12-011,H200,replace
H200-AX12-012,H200,replace
```

oliver_vendor: Also booked 6 loaners from our EU loaner pool (internal ID LN-EU-55). They will be on AWB 987-65432109 and pre-cleared for release to FRA DC.

jen_ops_mgr: Thanks. Nate, confirm we accept vendor covering up to EUR 5k. If fees exceed that, approve up to additional EUR 2k from contingency and escalate to finance for the rest.

nate_procure: Approved: vendor covers EUR 5k, we cover next EUR 2k. Anything > EUR 7k we escalate. Tell customs to push receipts to procurement for credit note.

samira_ops: Good. Ops checklist: 1) accept loaners into FRA DC, 2) hot-swap into prod racks, 3) stage returns for RMA pick-up. Claire, can you coordinate swap window 22:00-01:00 CET?

claire_hw: Yes — on-call team scheduled for 22:00. Will prepare rollback plan and KV cache pre-warm script.

forwarder_bot: Carrier note: DHL needs proof of vendor credit note or payment for detention before final release if customs generates an invoice > EUR 2k. Contact: oliver@atlaslogistics.com.

samira_ops: Oliver — please confirm you can issue interim vendor payment instruction to DHL if needed.

oliver_vendor: I confirm. We'll issue instruction and share payment ref. Also initiating RMA inbound pickup for the defective units to be collected from FRA DC within 48h of release.

samira_ops: Perfect. Postmortem ask: please include where the HS mismatch occurred (vendor pack vs carrier entry) so procurement can update SOPs.

oliver_vendor: Will include root cause. Initial glance shows carrier transposed code at booking. We'll add an extra doc check step.

jen_ops_mgr: Great. Closing items: loaners inbound (AWB 987-65432109), vendor covers up to EUR 5k, manifest uploaded, swap 22:00 CET. Samira — update #incidents if anything slips SLA. :thumbsup:

samira_ops: Will do. Thanks everyone — please ping here once loaners are in FRA DC.
